newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy diesel for September delivery.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy diesel for September delivery.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy high speed diesel for deliveries in September, traders said on Friday.
The tender seeks 0.5 percent sulphur diesel for deliveries to Madras or Haldia on the east coast and the 1.0-percent sulphur grade to the east coast and to Kandla on the west coast.
The tender closes on July 31 and offers will be valid until August 1.

IOC bought a total of 165,000 tonnes of 1.0 and 0.5 percent sulphur diesel in its last tender for August, which sent bearish ripples through the Asian and MidEast markets that had expected it to take at least 400,000 tonnes.
